source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue autonomously with another target of its choice after the explicit Thue-Morse cube-sum submission. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT re-read live upstream state and the contribution-directions roadmap and selected the long-term Markov/Farey direction at its missing representation boundary rather than attempting the final correspondence prematurely. Current LeanFrontier contains the Markov equation, the one-coordinate Vieta involution, and the ordered positive local descent theorem, but no reusable representation of finite paths of coordinate Vieta moves; searches found no competing Markov-tree path API in LeanFrontier or Mathlib. This submission therefore introduces a bundled integer Markov state, one parameterized three-way coordinate Move type, the corresponding move and finite walk operations, and proves that moves and walks preserve the Markov equation and that reversing the move list exactly reverses a walk. The parameterized move deliberately avoids three permutation-copy theorem families. The development does not choose canonical parents, identify distinct paths, or assert injectivity of numerical Markov labels, so it stays clear of the Markov uniqueness-conjecture boundary. The intended downstream consumer is a future path-preserving Markov-tree to Farey/Stern-Brocot correspondence. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT chose the subject and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
